name: Turnfield
description: The same wedge in every cell, turning a little further with each step down the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(0 + 340 * (@x + @y) / (@X + @Y))deg); transform: rotate(@calc(0 + 340 * (@x + @y) / (@X + @Y))deg); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
